activeWork.summary: Investigated and resolved 10+ GitHub CI build and SEO audit pipeline failures: 1) Diagnosed root cause via gh run view: npm ci was failing with EUSAGE due to package-lock.json being out-of-sync with package.json (missing @emnapi/core and @emnapi/runtime). 2) In scheduled-publish.yml, updated node-version from 20 to 22 to satisfy Astro 7.x engine requirements. 3) Ran npm install locally, audited packages, verified npm ci cleanly exits 0. 4) Committed 'd409958' and pushed to origin/main. 5) Synced PTW Control Center hub. 6) Monitored live GitHub Actions runs: both 'CI Build & SEO Audit Pipeline' (run 33499830551) and 'Scheduled Article Review' (run 33499900403) executed to 100% SUCCESS.
activeWork.nextAction: Resume next CEO 30-minute growth cycle targeting remaining striking-distance articles (hybrid-ai-routing or is-chatgpt-safe).

decisions.summary: Use repository-owned project memory before adding Graphiti.
decisions.reason: The repo already contains state.json, Mission Control, SQLite SEO memory, and agent rules; a graph service would add another state store and database dependency before the handoff contract is stable.
